user.title: eSCL scanner
user.description: Connect to a network scanner that speaks eSCL (Apple AirScan). Most modern HP, Canon, Epson, Brother, and Kyocera multifunction devices support this. For HTTPS scanners with self-signed certs, leave Verify TLS off. If you see SSL handshake failures, enable relaxed ciphers (needed for some HP LaserJet models that only offer non-PFS ciphers).

data.user: User name (for basic auth, if required)
data.password: Password (only if scanner requires basic auth)

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered scanner
zeroconf_confirm.description: Set up {name}? Credentials, TLS verification and scan defaults can be changed later in the integration's options.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the scanner. Check host/port/TLS settings. Detail: {error_detail}

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one scanner can be configured.

data.default_duplex: Scan both sides by default (ADF duplex, if supported)
data.copy_to_dir: Also copy finished scans to this folder (optional)

data_description.copy_to_dir: Absolute path, e.g. a Paperless consume folder. Must be listed under allowlist_external_dirs in configuration.yaml. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.file_ttl_seconds: Scans older than this are deleted from the integration's own storage. Copies made to the folder above are never deleted.

error.path_not_allowed: That folder is not in allowlist_external_dirs (configuration.yaml).

start.name: Start scan
start.description: Starts a scan on the configured eSCL scanner. Omitted fields use the integration's defaults; the source is auto-detected (ADF if loaded, else platen).

dpi.name: Resolution
dpi.description: Scan resolution in DPI; snaps to the nearest value the scanner supports.

duplex.name: Duplex
duplex.description: Scan both sides (Feeder only, duplex-capable ADFs).

cancel.name: Cancel scan
cancel.description: Cancels a running scan. Without a scan id, cancels the current scan.

scan_id.name: Scan ID
scan_id.description: The scan_id from the sensor attributes or the start response.
